audience: gym, sports club and community club managers who run memberships and bookings in Hello Club

useCases.title: Find members who owe money
useCases.text: The AI lists members with their amount owing and account credit, and lists transactions by paid state. You can total what is outstanding.

useCases.title: See upcoming events and classes and who signed up
useCases.text: The AI lists events and classes in a date range with capacity and attendance rules, and lists who signed up, with paid state and whether they attended.

useCases.title: Check court, room and lane bookings
useCases.text: The AI lists resource bookings with owner, activity, area, start and end and paid state, filtered by date range, member or area.

useCases.title: Review who checked in and door access logs
useCases.text: The AI lists check-ins with who, when and how, and door access logs in a date range. You can see who came to the club.

useCases.title: Add a member, a charge or a credit
useCases.text: The AI creates a new member, or creates a charge or credit on a member's account. A charge changes the member's amount owing.
